Professor Nir Giladi is one of the leading specialists in neurology. Holding the honoured position of vice-president of the International Parkinson and Movement Disorder Society, he is recognised as an expert of world class in the diagnosis and treatment of Parkinson's disease.

Over his academic and clinical career Professor Giladi has made a significant contribution to medical science, writing more than 200 research papers. His work is not only studied closely by specialists in the field but also serves as the basis for developing new methods of treatment and therapy.

Alongside his research and clinical contribution, Professor Giladi takes an active part in various international forums, symposia and conferences. His opinion and expertise are in high demand, and he is often invited as a keynote speaker at many events.

As vice-president of the international society, Giladi not only represents the interests of specialists but also takes an active part in developing new standards and methods for treating patients with movement disorders. His leadership, combined with deep knowledge and experience, makes him one of the key figures in the world of neurology.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of Medicine, Ben-Gurion University, Beersheba, Israel
  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation in neurology at the Carmel medical centre, Haifa, Israel
  • Specialisation in movement disorders at Columbia University, New York, USA
  • Fellowship in neurology at the University of Oxford, United Kingdom
  • Fellowships at leading neurological clinics in the Netherlands and China

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Neurological Association
  • Israel Parkinson's Disease Association
  • Member of the medical service board of the Israel Defence Forces
  • Vice-president of the International Parkinson and Movement Disorder Society
  • Research management committee for movement disorders

Surgeon, oncologist, Doctor of Medical Sciences, professor of surgery, head of the department of general and cancer surgery

Areas of clinical expertise:
Professor Nissan Aviram is an outstanding doctor from Israel specialising in surgery and oncology, with more than 36 years of practice.

Education and experience:

  • 1983-1986: Bachelor of Science (Biology), State Medical University in St Petersburg, Russia
  • Fellowship in endocrinology at the Institute of Endocrinology, Beilinson Medical Centre, Israel

Languages:

  • Russian
  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Endocrine Society
  • Israel Diabetes Association
  • European Society of Endocrinology

Areas of clinical expertise:
Professor Aviram is a recognised leader in the treatment of cancers, including cancer of the stomach, colon and rectum, soft tissue sarcoma and others. He performs robot-assisted laparoscopic operations and has developed a HIPEC technique for treating stomach cancer and other tumours.

Research:
Professor Aviram takes an active part in research, with a focus on developing innovative treatment methods, particularly for severe forms of diabetes. He works with the Institute of Endocrinology, where he carries out his research projects.

Awards and patents:

  • Winner of the Melvitsky prize (2000)
  • Winner of the Federico Foundation prize (2003)
  • Winner of the Aaron Beare Foundation prize (2003)
  • USMCI CBCP award (2007)

Professor Ofer Merimsky: an outstanding oncologist specialising in the treatment of sarcoma

Professional overview:
Professor Ofer Merimsky, head of the department of soft tissue and bone sarcoma, is a recognised specialist in oncology with some 40 years of medical experience. His approach to treating sarcoma, tumours of the brain and spine, breast cancer and other malignancies is marked by a comprehensive, multidisciplinary method that brings together the efforts of specialists in narrow fields.

Main specialisations:

  • Treatment of all forms of sarcoma
  • Tumours of the brain
  • Tumours of the spine
  • Cancer of the lungs and chest organs
  • Cancer of the uterus
  • Breast cancer
  • Prostate cancer
  • Kidney cancer
  • Treatment of gastrointestinal stromal tumours

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel
  • Residency in general oncology and radiation therapy, Israel
  • Fellowships at a New York cancer centre, USA, and at the Gustave Roussy Institute, France

Languages:

  • English
  • Hebrew
  • French

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy (ISCORT)
  • Connective Tissue Oncology Society (CTOS)
  • European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO)
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)
  • International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer (IASLC)

Professor Merimsky actively introduces innovative treatment methods, improving quality of life and offering hope to thousands of patients. His exceptional contribution to oncology is recognised internationally.

Professor Or Kaiserman is a highly qualified expert in ophthalmology and eye surgery. His specialisations include:

Refractive surgery:

  • Freedom from glasses through laser vision correction.
  • Advanced lenses for the correction of short-sightedness.
  • Correction of astigmatism by corneal incisions.

Keratoconus surgery:

  • Strengthening the cornea in keratoconus (corneal cross-linking).
  • Laser surgery for keratoconus.

Corneal transplantation:

  • Full corneal transplantation.
  • Partial transplantation of the anterior layers of the cornea.

Cataract surgery:

  • Cataract surgery using special artificial lenses (for near and distance vision, with correction of astigmatism).
  • Lens implantation in cataract surgery.

Other procedures:

  • Treatment of the meibomian glands.
  • Increasing tear production in the eyes.
  • Cosmetic whitening of the eye.
  • Pterygium surgery.

Education and specialisation:

  • Medical degree with distinction from the faculty of medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel.
  • Master's degree in public administration (MPA), Clark University, USA.
  • Certified specialist in diving medicine.
  • Certified specialist in ocular ultrasound, Munich, Germany.
  • ISO 9000 course in healthcare.
  • MSc in neuroscience, Hebrew University, Jerusalem.
  • Completed specialisation in ophthalmology (with distinction), Hadassah Ein Kerem Medical Centre, Jerusalem.
  • MSc in ophthalmology (with special distinction), Tel Aviv University.
  • Master's degree in healthcare systems management (MHA), Ben-Gurion University, Beersheba.
  • Advanced specialisation in surgery of the cornea and ocular surface and in freedom from glasses, Toronto, Canada.
  • Course in good clinical practice (GCP).

Languages:

  • Hebrew.
  • English.

Experience:

  • More than 20 years of clinical experience.

Clinical and academic experience:

  • Senior lecturer at Ben-Gurion University, Beersheba.
  • Chief ophthalmologist of the aviation medicine unit of the Israeli Air Force.
  • Head of the corneal surgery unit, ophthalmology department, Barzilai Medical Centre, Ashkelon, Israel.
  • Deputy chief medical officer of the Israeli Navy.
  • Head of the specialist outpatient clinics of the central region polyclinic at the Tzrifin military base.
  • Author of more than 100 research publications.
  • Participant and speaker at international and Israeli scientific conferences.
  • Awarded a certificate of honour by the American Academy of Ophthalmology for scientific achievement in 2007.

Membership of associations:

  • Israel Ophthalmological Society.
  • Israel Society for Vision and Eye Research.
  • Israel Medical Association.
  • Association for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology, USA.

Dr Oren Shibolet is a leading Israeli hepatologist specialising in the treatment of drug-induced liver injury and fatty degeneration of the liver cells.

Education and experience:

  • Graduate of the faculty of medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
  • Fellowship at the Hadassah Medical Centre in gastroenterology and the treatment of liver disease.
  • Advanced specialisation in gastroenterology at Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH), Boston, USA.
  • Experience as a senior physician in the department of internal medicine and liver disease at the Hadassah hospital.
  • Head of the hepatology department at the Ichilov-Sourasky clinic in Tel Aviv.

Specialisation:

  • Treatment of severe liver disease.
  • Treatment of liver cancer.
  • Treatment of liver damage caused by alcohol and drugs.
  • Treatment of fatty liver disease and of genetic, viral and autoimmune liver conditions.

Professional activity:

  • Lectures in the faculty of medicine at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
  • Author of more than 60 research papers published in medical journals.
  • Active participation in medical conferences and seminars.

Research collaborations:

  • Collaboration with the gastroenterology department of Massachusetts General Hospital (Boston, USA).
  • Participation in research on molecular processes in biology and cell signalling.

Leadership:

  • Head of a research group at the Israel Academy of Sciences and the international cancer research fund.

Membership of professional associations:

  • Israel Gastroenterology Association.
  • Israel Association for the Study of the Liver.
  • American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases.
  • European Association for the Study of the Liver.
  • American Gastroenterological Association.

Radiologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Computed tomography (CT)
  • Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
  • Diagnosis of cancerous tumours
  • Imaging of complex cancers
  • Expert assessment of surgical intervention
  • Imaging of liver disease and liver tumours
  • Imaging in organ transplantation
  • CT and urography of the kidneys and urinary tract
  • CT angiography

Summary:

Professor Arik Blachar is a leading radiologist in Israel and an expert in computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging. He heads the CT and MRI units of the radiology department at the Ichilov-Sourasky medical centre and has 25 years of professional experience.

Professor Blachar was largely trained in the United States, which speaks to his high level of qualification. He has specialised in the imaging of complex cancers, the expert assessment of surgical intervention, the imaging of liver disease and liver tumours, imaging in organ transplantation, CT and urography of the kidneys and urinary tract, and CT angiography. He has extensive experience in diagnosing internal hernias and bowel disease, assessing the progression of Crohn's disease and carrying out post-operative assessment with CT.

Dr Blachar qualified as a doctor at the state university in Beersheba, Israel, and completed his residency at the Hadassah medical centre in diagnostic radiology.

Education and clinical experience:

  • 2020 to the present: Head of the CT and MRI units, Ichilov-Sourasky Medical Centre
  • 2013: Senior physician, radiology department, Sheba Medical Centre, Tel HaShomer
  • 2010-2013: Clinical specialisation in CT of the abdomen and pelvis, University of Pittsburgh
  • 2010-2013: MRI of the abdomen and pelvis, Philadelphia
  • 2010-2013: Virtual colonoscopy, Boston
  • 2010-2013: Perfusion imaging of the pelvis and abdomen, Chicago
  • 2010-2013: Research work, University of Pittsburgh
  • 2005-2010: Residency, Hadassah Medical Centre
  • 2000-2005: Faculty of medicine, state university in Beersheba

Academic and research work:

Professor Blachar is actively engaged in research in radiology. He is the author of more than 60 papers published in leading international journals. Examples of his work include:

  • Cystic tumours of the pancreas: high malignant potential
  • Primary biliary cirrhosis
  • CT assessment of the liver: principles and methods

Membership of international associations:

  • European Society of Gastrointestinal and Abdominal Radiology
  • Radiological Society of North America
  • Israel Radiological Association

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Consulting hours:

  • Sunday: 16:00-20:00
  • Wednesday: 17:00-20:30
